SELECT legend_id AS legendId, rank_no AS rankNo FROM site_legend_preferences WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY rank_no
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM site_legend_material_states WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND material_id = #{materialId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_legend_material_states (user_id, material_id, state) VALUES (#{userId}, #{materialId}, #{state}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state = VALUES(state)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM site_legend_states WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND legend_id = #{legendId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO site_legend_states (user_id, legend_id, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{legendId}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status)
INSERT INTO site_legend_preferences (user_id, legend_id, rank_no) VALUES (#{userId}, #{legendId}, #{rankNo})
mapper.select: SELECT d.day_no AS dayNo, d.round_no AS roundNo, d.round_label AS roundLabel, l.id AS legendId, l.legend_name AS legendName, p.rank_no AS rankNo, COALESCE(ls.status, 'NONE') AS legendStatus, m.id AS materialId, m.player_name AS playerName, m.season_year AS seasonYear FROM site_legend_preferences p JOIN data_player_legend l ON l.id = p.legend_id JOIN data_player_legend_material m ON m.legend_id = l.id AND m.material_type = 'PLAYER' JOIN data_history_roster r ON r.player_name = m.player_name AND r.season_year = m.season_year JOIN data_history_round d ON d.id = r.round_id LEFT JOIN site_legend_states ls ON ls.user_id = p.user_id AND ls.legend_id = l.id LEFT JOIN site_legend_material_states ms ON ms.user_id = p.user_id AND ms.material_id = m.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND ms.material_id IS NULL ORDER BY d.day_no, d.round_no, p.rank_no, m.slot_no
